lint.command: uv run ruff check . && { command -v shellcheck >/dev/null || { echo "lint: required 'shellcheck' executable was not found; run 'just bootstrap' from the repository root to install it, then retry" >&2; exit 1; }; } && shellcheck scripts/*.sh .githooks/pre-push && uv run orchestrator-validate-personas

test.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 COVERAGE_FILE=.coverage.parallel uv run pytest -m 'not reads_docs and not reads_recipes and not single_threaded' -n 4 --dist loadgroup --cov=orchestrator --cov-report= --cov-fail-under=0

test-serial.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 COVERAGE_FILE=.coverage.serial uv run coverage run -m pytest -m 'not reads_docs and not reads_recipes and single_threaded' --no-cov

coverage.command: rm -f .coverage && env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run coverage combine .coverage.serial .coverage.parallel && env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run coverage report

test-docs.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest -m reads_docs --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup

test-recipes.command: env -u FORCE_COLOR NO_COLOR=1 uv run pytest -m reads_recipes --no-cov -n 4 --dist loadgroup
